description.value:
Most people never leave the system they were born in, let alone the sector. You are the exception — you come from a world so distant that few people you meet have done more than hear its name, and fewer still know anything true about it.

Everywhere you go, you're a curiosity: your manner, your assumptions, and your accent all mark you as an outsider, for better or worse, wherever your travels have taken you.

toolProficiencies: One musical instrument or gaming set of your choice
system.equipment: A set of traveler's clothes, a musical instrument or gaming set you are proficient with, worn maps from your homeland, a small piece of jewelry worth 100 credits, and a pouch containing 50 credits.
